format:

params:
  people_id: 19548
  ga: null  # The archived General Assembly; null = CURRENT_GA

```{r}
# Archived session page: one earlier session of a member who served in a
# later one, rendered once (render_legislator_archives() in render.R).
# Renders to docs/legislators/ga91/, two directories below docs/, which is
# why this template sits one level deeper than legislator_template.qmd.
up <- 2
```

{{< include ../_legislator_data.qmd >}}

```{r}
# The career page shows the person's latest session; its filename comes from
# that session's people.csv (the chamber prefix can change between sessions)
sessions <- legislator_sessions() |> filter(people_id == params$people_id)
career_filename <- get_legislator_filename(
  params$people_id, sessions |> filter(ga == latest_ga)
)
career_href <- paste0("../", career_filename, ".html")

archive_notice <- sprintf(
  "This is %s's record in the %s (%s). <a href='%s'>Current page and electoral history →</a>",
  legislator$name, ga_label(ga), ga_years(ga), career_href
)

district_extra <- NULL
```

::: {.ia-breadcrumb}
[Legislators](../index.html) / [`r legislator$name`](`r career_href`) / `r ga_label(ga)`
:::

```{r}
ui_profile_header(
  name       = legislator$name,
  party      = legislator$party,
  role_label = role_label,
  district   = legislator$district,
  notice     = paste(c(succession_notice, archive_notice), collapse = "<br>"),
  links      = links_div
)
```
